description: One call: create a curated Swedish high-school graduation (studenten) gift wishlist and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Preferred agent path: create a wishlist and add ASINs / keywords / search queries in one call. OpenAPI: agentCreateAndFill.

itemQueries.description: Each query is searched and added as a wish

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED.

name: create_and_fill
title: One-shot create and fill
